_what: a11ign's per-project declaration: the ONE file `agent-org` reads to learn which repository and which board it serves (ADR 0040, decisions 1 and 2; #2616). Keys starting with an underscore are prose and are not read.
_key: The EMPTY key belongs to the host's primary project's first code repository and first tracker, so every existing name, ledger line and label keeps its meaning. A key is [a-z0-9-], unique within its list, and never ends in -<digits>.
_layers: `tracker` holds ONE entry until #2612's layer repositories exist. `code` holds a second, `agent-org` (#2969), a third, `screenreader-worker` (#2701, move 1 of #69), a fourth, `documents` (#2705, move 5 of #69), and a fifth, `screenreader-fleet` (#2702, move 2 of #69): a repository the org opens pull requests in has to be DECLARED or no pull-request cause (review, red, conflict, stall) ever reads it, and the keyed reviewer `reviewer-agent-org-<n>` reviews from the clone `host.json` names under `clones`.
_beforeTick: The command the host runs in THIS checkout before each tick, now the tool no longer lives in it (ADR 0040, decision 3; #2623 done-when 4; cut-over 3 of 6, #2974): it keeps this checkout at origin/main. The tool form, `agent-org primary:update` (a11ign/agent-org#179): the work-tick unit renders a first word of `agent-org` through the tool itself, so it no longer resolves the project's pinned copy (#3503).
_dora: The seven repositories the daily DORA reading measures (ADR 0041, decision 7; #3138), read by `src/dora.mjs` of a11ign/agent-org. Each is listed from the day it exists, EVEN WHEN EMPTY, so the page shows it as unfinished until it has released. `release.kind` is `npm` (the registry's publish time is the release) or `tag` (a GitHub Release is). The reader takes ONE `package` per npm repository, so a11ign names `a11ign`, the command, which releases with the three libraries `evidence`, `judge` and `scorer` in one version pull request; `releasablePaths` are the directories whose change counts as releasable. WHEN A PACKAGE MOVES, ITS MOVE ROW UPDATES ITS ENTRY HERE (packages/lab/src/packaging/dora-declaration.test.ts reads each against this workspace's manifests until then).
_units: The unit files this project installs from the tool's own templates are named `<prefix><name>`; the project's OWN units (its corpus and fleet clocks) live in `.agent-org/units/` and `own` lists them, which is the project's half of the partition `host-units.mjs` records the tool's half of. `boardReportWorkflow` is the workflow the tool's board-report unit dispatches on the first tracker's repository (#2620, child 3f of #69; ADR 0040, decision 9).
_roles: Where this project's role briefs live (ADR 0040, decision 1, surface 3; #2621, child 3e of #69), read by `src/project-roles.mjs` of a11ign/agent-org. The tool ships none of its own; `sessions.json` and every `<role>.md` are a11ign's, at `dir`.
_causes: The project's own addition to the gate's 30 tool causes (ADR 0040, decision 1, surface 3; #2621, child 3e of #69), read by `src/cause-declaration.mjs` of a11ign/agent-org's `projectCauseDeclarations`. ABSENT reads as none -- a project with no fleet, lab or corpus declares no plugin and gets no fleet cause. `module` is resolved relative to this file's own directory (`.agent-org/`), and its file must export a `causeDeclarations` array built with `declareCause`.
_messaging: The chairman's messaging channel (a11ign/a11ign#2899; docs/messaging.md decision 1), read by `src/messaging/config.mjs` of a11ign/agent-org. Its presence is what makes `host:install` write the `chairman-watch` pair; ABSENT is OFF. Both paths are REFERENCES to files under `~/.config/agent-org/`: the secret is read from them when used and is never written in this file. No `summary` key, so the tool's own defaults (08:00, Europe/London) apply (#3142).
_leakPatterns: What a11ign's public prose must never carry, ON TOP OF the two the tool holds itself (a private LAN IPv4 address, a named SSH key file). Each `pattern` is a regular expression's SOURCE. #1875: the control plane's GitHub token file sits beside the fleet key and is guarded for the same reason -- where a credential sits on a real box is somebody's infrastructure written down. ADR 0013: the retired `pct exec` container-hop idiom. #2658 (child 3g of #69) split these two out of packages/lab/src/packaging/leak-patterns.mjs, which the product keeps.

_vocabulary: The row template's own words and the tool's shared-resource ban (ADR 0040, decision 1, surface 2; #2619, child 3d of #69), read by `src/project-vocabulary.mjs` of a11ign/agent-org. THE FOUR CLAIM-LIFECYCLE LABELS (`ready`, `was-ready`, `in-progress`, `started`) ARE DELIBERATELY NOT HERE: `claim-labels.mjs` is a pinned, import-free LEAF module (`ready-label-audit.test.ts`, #804) so nothing depending on it can form a cycle through `row-claim.mjs`'s rule-set graph, and `project-vocabulary.mjs` imports them from that one owner rather than stating the same four facts twice.
